name: @liustack/modsearch
bundleDefaults:
# dsh bundle layer: mount the modsearch web plugin (dsh/index.js via the
# package root export; bin stays the CLI, nothing imports the root otherwise)
# and route the web seam's search capability to it. A patch row replaces the
# targeted row's whole config, so this row restates every base key: the base
# layer pins `searchProvider: deepseek-official` and `fetchProvider: http`,
# and dropping the fetch pin makes web_fetch ambiguous once the host also
# registers deepseek-fetch-api (#43). A later profile patch can pin any
# provider back.
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: modsearch
    fetchProvider: http

- insert:
    - id: modsearch
      name: '@liustack/modsearch'
notice: Upstream defaults are evidence, not a generated personal configuration. Retain linked upstream licenses. / 上游默认值仅作证据，不是个人配置。
